header:
How office landlords
cope with empty desks

lines.text: In September, 1 in 8 bond-backed office loans was late.
lines.say: In September, one in eight bond-backed office loans was late.

lines.text: That's Trepp's office CMBS delinquency rate for September 2026: 12.16%.
lines.say: That's Trepp's office rate for September twenty twenty-six: twelve point one six percent.

lines.text: It was 2.53% in December 2021, and 11.31% four years later.
lines.say: It was two point five three percent in December twenty twenty-one, and eleven point three one percent four years later.

lines.text: Why? Empty desks. US office vacancy was 19.8% in Q3 2026, per Cushman & Wakefield.
lines.say: Why? Empty desks. US office vacancy was nineteen point eight percent in the third quarter, per Cushman and Wakefield.

lines.text: And Green Street says $100 of office value at the 2022 peak was $66 by June 2026.
lines.say: And Green Street says a hundred dollars of office value at the twenty twenty-two peak was sixty-six by June twenty twenty-six.

lines.text: So landlords bargain: free rent, cash to build out the space, or turning offices into apartments.
lines.say: So landlords bargain: free rent, cash to build out the space, or turning offices into apartments.

lines.text: Example: a 10-year lease at $50 a foot, with a year free, really pays $45. The sticker still says $50.
lines.say: Example: a ten-year lease at fifty dollars a foot, with a year free, really pays forty-five. The sticker still says fifty.

lines.text: Meanwhile, top towers fill up while older buildings empty out.
lines.say: Meanwhile, top towers fill up while older buildings empty out.

post.title: 1 in 8 office CMBS loans was late. How landlords cope
post.ig:
In September 2026, roughly 1 in 8 office loans sold to bond investors was behind on payments.
Trepp's office CMBS delinquency rate was 12.16% in September 2026, near January's record of 12.34%. It was 2.53% in December 2021.
Cushman & Wakefield puts US office vacancy at 19.8% in Q3 2026, and Green Street's office values were 34% below their 2022 peak in June 2026.
Landlords cope with free rent, build-out cash and conversions: RentCafe counted 90,300 office-to-apartment units in the pipeline at the start of 2026, up 28% in a year.
Sources: Trepp (via Scotsman Guide, MBA NewsLink), Cushman & Wakefield, Green Street, RentCafe.
